scope: ADR0018 independent expectations and bounded acceptance requirements. Execution bindings are reviewed corpus tests; this file does not configure the runtime.

queue.overflow: truncated; whole attempted transaction rollback; previous commits and attempted work retained

guardSelection.scope: One pure allocation plan. Early-release preflight and final plan are separately work-metered.

arithmeticModel.description: Two actors, one already post-shield numeric incoming component each, owned by the opponent. Not full engine simulation. Before-hit/status/revival/geometry are excluded. defeat means an already eligible unresisted request.
arithmeticModel.fieldMeaning: drainBpsOnIncoming credits the opponent only if that damage source has opening hp>0, using its recovery multiplier and this target numeric basis. Opening hp=0 forces effective ordinary healing, drainBasis and drainReceived to0 in every allocation. Keep accepted target damage/basis; do not redistribute skipped credits or backfill them on revival. expected.drainBasis is capacity before drain rate even when credit is disabled; final HP0 alone does not exclude an opening-alive source.
arithmeticModel.expectations: Authored independently from the proposed arithmetic, not recorded from a production resolver; verification must assert them, not regenerate them.

N1.meaning: Least fixed point: mutual survival must not spend guards.

N2.meaning: Adding one required guard makes the other necessary; add simultaneously per round.

N3.meaning: Both require a guard in the first growth round.

N4.meaning: Unavailable guard cannot be selected when reduced opposing drain becomes lethal.

N5.meaning: No eligible guards retains nonrecursive legacy drain arithmetic.

N6.meaning: Damage3 plus defeat plus heal5 cannot survive without guard.

N7.meaning: Damage20 plus defeat with guard permits at most9 numeric drain basis.

N8.meaning: Pure defeat produces no numeric drain basis.

N9.meaning: Pure defeat with guard consumes one guard but creates no numeric damage.

N10.meaning: Defeat overrides incoming drain even if ordinary arithmetic would survive.

N11.meaning: Early-release combined wave: A hp3 takes5 while pending damage4 to B drains4 to A; no revival.

N12.meaning: An opening-dead source stays dead despite ordinary heal and outgoing drain.

N13.meaning: One floor after drain rate and recipient recovery multiplier: floor(1*0.5*1.5)=0.

N14.meaning: Same-wave ordinary healing increases numeric capacity before guard floor, without drain feedback.

C1.given: No stop; repeated and mapped actor/slot/position/RNG permutations.
C1.expected: Legacy domain progression/results/events/paths unchanged; all hashes repeat and mapped outcomes symmetric.

C2.given: Freeze while moving, casting, regenerating, pulsing, homing and observing; fixed/following objects.
C2.expected: All subject domains stop; detached area/global lifetimes continue; no catch-up, new costs or hidden observation delivery.

C3.given: Seal alone, seal with freeze, phasing exit-pending at global safety limit.
C3.expected: Seal alone does not pause time; freeze does. Exit safety still reaches truncated with recorded causes, never defeat or forced ejection.

C4.given: Two opposing stops; resistance on one; existing active control; repeat request.
C4.expected: Both valid requests fizzle; one invalid request cannot cancel the valid one; nesting/refresh do not extend.

C5.given: Many queued contacts, shields and changed defense before release.
C5.expected: One simultaneous release wave, original launch power/captured geometry, one opening defense snapshot and shared shield.

C6.given: Before-hit candidates on captured contacts, after-damage/revival on release.
C6.expected: No retroactive parry/deflection; normal bounded release reactions; cost/hit/cause consumption exactly once.

C7.given: N11 versus N12, available revival, late reaction cost/wave, timeout or release overflow.
C7.expected: N11 survives without revival; N12 cannot heal from HP0. Probe never consumes a guard/revival/event. Normal finality flushes all; errors immediately stop and preserve committed queue. No extra boundary pulse.

C8.given: Same-boundary paid teleport/placement and new stop; teleport escapes activation range; source already frozen.
C8.expected: Valid commands precede new stop; post-spatial range can fizzle stop; previously frozen source command fizzles without refund, not deferred.

C9.given: Duration-one stop [s,s+1), due release plus re-stop, early release near match limit.
C9.expected: One frozen interval; release and re-stop add no tick/catch-up; retain full semantic duration reservation and final battle-ended command rules.

C10.given: G=100, recipient clock60, new status duration10; action/force deadlines and different-clock deflection.
C10.expected: Subject end70/global activation100/global projection110. Projection is not expiry during freeze. Thaw rebinds it; shot remaining lifetime unchanged across owners. Different-age shots in one hit group use global re-hit time, never cross-instance age subtraction.

C11.given: Touching attached emitter freezes and resumes; frozen hovering/resource carry.
C11.expected: No separation credit for omitted emission/global gap; resumed clearance required. Frozen maintenance and carries do not progress; ordinary unfrozen hovering still pays.

C12.given: Source crosses target via teleport after capture; captured blast blocker later disappears.
C12.expected: Force uses captured direction and starts at release; coverage/falloff/occlusion remain captured, not recomputed from release geometry.

C13.given: Innate/temporary/sealed immunity; later immunity; source seal/incapacity/interruption; ordinary control dispel.
C13.expected: Effective immunity resists activation only. Active global control persists until its explicit end/lethal release; ordinary dispel/seal cannot remove it; no hidden AI details.

D1.given: Pure defeat against shields/ordinary resistance and explicit effective immunity.
D1.expected: Only dedicated effective immunity stops accepted defeat; no damage/drain/absorption or synthetic after-damage.

D2.given: N6; separately pure defeat with an eligible explicit revive-to7 response.
D2.expected: N6 HP0; explicit revive resets to7 after all waves and pays exactly once; ordinary heals do not revive.

D3.expected: HP1, one guard charge, numeric drain basis9; no revival use.

D4.given: Opening wound/status prerequisite versus same-wave new wound/status; whole/damage parry and deflected defeat.
D4.expected: Only opening predicate qualifies; whole parry blocks contact, damage-only retains defeat; returned payload affects original source.

D5.given: N10/N11 versus N12 and actor swaps; opening-dead and returned sources; later explicit revival.
D5.expected: N12: dead source HP/guard/basis/drain all0 before final HP clamp; target HP6/basis4, no redirected credit. Later revival does not back-credit it. N10 retains drainReceived4 but defeat sets HP0; N11 survives at HP2 without revival. Returned payload cannot drain.

D6.given: Multiple numeric contributions with heal/shield/absorption, N13 rounding, disabled/periodic/environment cases.
D6.expected: Exact proportional rational basis only over numeric damage, one floor per drain contribution; no drain feedback or synthetic defeat contribution.

I1.given: Two simultaneous lethal contacts, next lethal wave, timeout release and exhausted count.
I1.expected: One charge per allocation wave, not per attack; later waves can consume next charge; fifth never protects when C=4.

I2.expected: Spent count survives all lifecycle changes; no retroactive grant; suppressed/expired guard does not protect.

I3.given: Numeric N1-N14 and exact actor swaps.
I3.expected: Independent expected HP/guard/basis/drain values match; choose least fixed point and preserve no-guard arithmetic.

I4.given: N1 has another fixed point; N2 has cascaded requirements; probe fails.
I4.expected: N1 spends zero, N2 grows twice; at most three allocations; probes never mutate counters, RNG, HP or events.

I5.given: C=1 guard regranted after use; C=4 after four uses; conflicting recipient closure.
I5.expected: No further protection after each match allowance; input rejects conflicts including opposing/dormant grants, equipment and transforms.

X1.given: Missing permissions; dormant unsupported variants; conflicting immortality revisions.
X1.expected: Reject with mechanic/revision before prepare/job/retry/league reservation; preserve existing input omission behavior.

X2.given: All accepted ordered/self/conditional matrix cells, deleted cell/fixture, unresolved pair.
X2.expected: Independent executed assertions cover each accepted rule, negatives fail, undefined experimental cases emit bounded ADR0016 diagnostics.

X3.given: Isolated exact/+1 contacts/operations/bytes, 200 captures released then100 more, simultaneous group overflow.
X3.expected: Exact succeeds with other bounds nonbinding; overflow is atomic truncated. Release reduces occupancy only. Work persists but candidate queue/HP/RNG/IDs/ledger/clocks/records roll back.

X4.given: Repeated hashes, injected rollback, old/new Worker/SQLite/checkpoints, both viewers.
X4.expected: All state hashes stable; rollback includes world/queues/clock/resource/identity state; round-trip immutable published definitions and saved records.

X5.given: Delayed/private observation, pending display, forward/reverse/loop seek, partial/invalid records.
X5.expected: No enemy hidden-state leak or early queued HP; no combat rerun; malformed/unsupported data explicitly rejects, valid partial errors remain inspectable.

X6.given: Clock projection, missing feature declaration, duplicate release/consumption, missing checkpoint descriptor.
X6.expected: Engine-free validation rejects inconsistency; projections never expire state; consumed and pending are exclusive; global release-only ordering is monotone.

perceptionConcepts.absoluteHit: no-error aim only; two PRNG draws; range/geometry/occlusion/delayed aim retained
perceptionConcepts.evasion: whole hostile contact; optional categories AND elements; effective finite status; after before-hit payment; excludes self/environment/periodic effects
perceptionConcepts.precision: positive bounded basis-point buckets; high clipped at 10000
perceptionConcepts.occlusion: vision only; revealWardBps must be strictly lower than powerBps
